item.title: PortWin 1.16
item.description:
• Automatic updates: PortWin now checks for new versions once a day and installs them in one click (PortWin → Check for Updates…)
  • If Rosetta 2 is missing on your Mac, PortWin now explains it and installs it for you instead of failing with a "Bad CPU type" error
  • New items in the PortWin menu: PortWin Website and Buy PortWin
